name: nginx
description: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
one_liner: The engine that quietly routes traffic for a huge share of the websites on the internet — not a product you'd sell, but the plumbing underneath almost everything.
buyer: Not really a single buyer — it's free infrastructure every hosting company and web team already relies on, so there's no new business to build by using it alone.
business_use_cases: A hosting company configures it to serve thousands of customer sites reliably, as part of infrastructure they already sell.
A DevOps consultancy charges clients to tune and harden their nginx configuration for performance and security.
A web agency bundles 'nginx setup and SSL' as a line item in website-build packages for small business clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid nginx configuration audits and performance tuning for small businesses running their own servers.
Bundle managed-nginx hosting with support as a premium tier of a broader hosting business.

steal_this: Honestly, there's no new weekend product here — the only realistic move is offering a $200 'secure your nginx server' audit to local businesses that self-host.
